name: Nintedanib Esylate

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Hepatic impairment: Nintedanib capsules are not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe hepatic impairment. summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave this medicine a medium score of 61 for liver risk and a low score of 35 for heart risk [M]. Official warnings state that the capsules are not recommended for people with moderate or severe hepatic impairment, which means moderate or severe liver damage [3]. For patients with mild liver damage, the suggested dose is 100 mg twice a day taken with food, roughly 12 hours apart [3].
